description: Compiled Web Components on JSX/TSX: a compiler that hoists static HTML into templates and turns each dynamic expression into a direct binding, a zero-dependency signals runtime, SSR with hydration, a store and accessible UI components.
rules: Install @surgijs/core for the runtime and @surgijs/compiler as a dev dependency; add the plugin from @surgijs/compiler/vite to vite.config.ts.
Components are plain functions that take props and return JSX; defineComponent(tag, render, schema) registers them as custom elements.
Props are getters: read them in JSX as {title} and call them in plain TypeScript as step().
Use useState, useMemo and useEffect from @surgijs/core for reactivity; use For, Show, Switch, Portal and ErrorBoundary for control flow instead of array.map and ternaries over elements.
Server rendering comes from @surgijs/core/server (renderToString, renderToStream); the client adopts the server markup with enableHydration from @surgijs/core/hydrate.
@surgijs/store is independent of the runtime; @surgijs/ui components need @surgijs/core as a peer.
